curlExamples.name: 使用curl测试北京路线
curlExamples.command: curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/api/route/map" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"locations":["北京天安门","故宫博物院","景山公园"],"strategy":"walking","includeSteps":true}'

curlExamples.name: 使用PowerShell测试
curlExamples.command: $body = @{locations=@('北京天安门','故宫博物院','景山公园'); strategy='walking'; includeSteps=$true} | ConvertTo-Json; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/route/map' -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'

pythonExample.code:
import requests
import json

url = 'http://localhost:8080/api/route/map'
headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
data = {
    'locations': ['北京天安门', '故宫博物院', '景山公园'],
    'strategy': 'walking',
    'includeSteps': True
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=data)
result = response.json()

if result['code'] == 200:
    print('地图生成成功!')
    print('地图URL:', result['data']['mapUrl'])
    print('路线距离:', result['data']['route']['distance'], '米')
    print('预计耗时:', result['data']['route']['duration'], '秒')
else:
    print('请求失败:', result['message'])
